validation.notes: Repaired three coupled lifecycle fences. (1) runtime/drive/tools.ts: recoverToolInvocation now honors its cancelled argument, so a cancelled recovery reads the durable checkpoint and publishes one interrupted outcome instead of clearing the checkpoint and re-invoking the effect; the non-cancelled safe/safe replay still clears, invokes with persisted arguments, preserves details/usage and publishes once. (2) execution/tools.ts: executeToolCall's update latch is now closed in finally (acceptingUpdates = false), so live updates and checkpoint writes stop when the effect completes, for both successful and throwing effects. (3) execution/effect-gate.ts: beginAbort returns unless the gate is open, so a closed gate cannot be reopened and its terminal error cannot be replaced (verified through gate.admit and executeToolCall). The regression loads the real modules via .prale-eval/subject.mjs with only checkpoint storage/progress/event IO faked, uses uncaught node:assert/strict assertions and microtask-only ordering (no timers, randomness, network or credentials). Focused validation additionally restored each repaired file alone to its faulty baseline (packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts, packages/agent/src/harness/execution/tools.ts, packages/agent/src/harness/execution/effect-gate.ts); every single-file restoration produced an assertion failure (scheduler: clear/invoke observed; executor: post-completion update event; gate: AbortRequested replacing the terminal error) rather than a crash, import error or timeout. Limitation: the repository's TypeScript type check and Vitest suites could not be executed because node_modules/dependencies are not installed in this workspace; the script itself needs only Node 24 built-ins.
